description: Writes ``src/MCEq/geometry/cutoff_maps.json``: for every site of :func:`MCEq.geometry.atmosphere_parameters.site_coordinates`, the cutoff in GV of downgoing protons on a 5° grid of zenith (0–90°) and azimuth (0–355°, 0° is North, 90° East). A direction's cutoff is the lowest rigidity, scanned upward in 0.1 GV steps, whose gtracr trajectory escapes the IGRF field at :data:`MCEq.geometry.cutoff.CUTOFF_DATE`, started 100 km above the site.
